name: Ironpass AcidSeal Chrome-Wrap Rain Sleeve — Pair
description: Fitted over-sleeves in matte black vulcanized polymer designed specifically to sheath chrome arms and exposed spinal conduits during Shelf and Circuit acid rainfall. Fastens with industrial compression snaps along the inner seam. Lightweight, unobtrusive, and purpose-built — popular among aug-users who can't afford full corrosion-resistant chrome upgrades.
functionality: Full acid-rain barrier for exposed chrome limbs; compression-sealed edges prevent seepage at shoulder and wrist joints.
what_it_says: This person has chrome worth protecting and the practicality to do it without spending a fortune.
story_hooks: The left sleeve was split cleanly by something sharp — the owner patched it with electrical tape and won't say what happened.
A batch of counterfeits has been circulating that look identical but dissolve in Grade-3 acid rainfall within minutes.
